summary: Two KPI cards with an icon and a sparkline under the number: a line for active users and bars for churn, with a hint line.
use: A metric tile that shows its recent history. The chart is a snippet, so the charts subpath stays out of the core entry.
spec: `<KpiCard title="Active users" value="24.8k" trend={12.1} icon={Users}>` with `{#snippet chart()}<Sparkline data={[18, 19, 21, 20, 23, 25]} trend="up" />{/snippet}`

`hint="Down from 2.4% in January"` on the churn card, whose chart is `<Sparkline data={[2.4, 2.3, 2.1, 2.2, 1.9, 1.7]} trend="up" variant="bar" />`: `trend="up"` is green because a falling churn is good
